name: Create Flow
description: Guidance for a short creation workflow opened from a page-level action into governed Dialog, with governed form controls, product-owned validation/request state, inline failure feedback, and a success outcome returned to the originating page.

structure.role: A governed Button opens the creation workflow; it may be composed in Page Heading actions when that placement is appropriate.
Governed Dialog owns the modal surface, modal semantics, focus containment, Escape handling, and focus restoration.
Compose the governed form controls required by the product data model; Text Field and Radio Group are evidenced examples, not mandatory fields for every create task.
Render governed Inline Feedback inside the Dialog when a recoverable request failure needs explicit explanation while preserving entered values.
Compose governed Buttons in Dialog actions for cancellation and submission; product/workflow owns labels, pending restrictions, retry state, and outcomes.

layout.statement: Use governed Dialog for the modal surface and place product form content only in its body/actions composition; do not recreate Dialog geometry with local CSS.
When the create action is page-level, prefer the governed Page Heading actions slot if the page already uses Page Heading; otherwise product composition owns trigger placement.

responsive.statement: Use the governed Dialog responsive/viewport behavior; do not substitute a drawer or sheet on narrow screens without separate approved guidance.

direction.statement: Dialog and form controls inherit the surrounding writing direction; only intrinsically directional product values may set a narrower direction.

accessibility.statement: All form controls require the governed visible/accessibility labels defined by their contracts, and the Dialog close label must be localized for the surrounding language.
Rely on governed Dialog focus entry, containment, Escape handling, background inertness, and focus restoration instead of reimplementing those behaviors.

behavior.statement: Open state, field values, validation, dirty state, request phase, retries, and success/failure outcomes belong to the product/workflow rather than Dialog.
Product validation supplies the supported invalid/error state of governed form controls; do not invent validation APIs on Dialog.
For a recoverable create failure, keep entered values available for correction/retry and use governed Inline Feedback when an explanatory message is needed.
After successful creation, close the Dialog and update the originating product state; any success feedback on the page is product-owned.
Deterministic fail-then-retry behavior used by Storybook prototypes is demo evidence only and must not be inferred as a product creation rule.

allowed.statement: Local CSS may arrange product-owned content inside Dialog slots only where no governed component or spacing token already owns that decision.

forbidden: custom modal implementation when governed Dialog satisfies the requirement
inventing onSubmit, requestStatus, pending, validation, or dirty props on Dialog
reimplementing Dialog focus trap, Escape handling, backdrop, or focus restoration
treating prototype fail-then-retry timing as canonical product behavior
inventing a narrow drawer or sheet replacement without separate approved guidance
